minutes.headline: Personnel Committee voted 3-2 to grandfather current SAP staff's longevity pay and set new-hire rates by job type.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed moving non-union SAP longevity pay from a percentage of salary to flat amounts matched to the clerical or police/fire schedules. Employees on the call and several members objected to taking money from current staff. A motion passed to grandfather current employees, with new department heads on police/fire amounts and new clerical staff on clerical amounts, and the article was then moved forward as amended.

public_comment.topic: An SAP employee said flat longevity would cost a long-serving employee tens of thousands over a career and asked that existing employees be grandfathered; non-union staff cannot negotiate.
A department head said SAP staff have no representative to negotiate and asked for grandfathering of current staff.
An employee said other groups negotiated trade-offs the SAP did not, and SAP staff work 40 hours or more so should not be matched to the clerical schedule.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted 3-2 to keep current non-union SAP employees' longevity pay as it is, with new hires on flat schedules by job type.
New department heads would follow the police/fire longevity amounts, and new non-department-head clerical staff would follow the clerical amounts.
The committee had been weighing a move from percentage-of-salary longevity to flat amounts. Staff on the call objected to taking pay from current employees.
The article was moved to the select board as amended, but the recording does not make the vote audible.
The committee said the longevity change needs to be in the annual town meeting article. If the article is deferred to fall town meeting, it would only need to add positions to the grid.

why_it_matters: This sets how non-union town staff are paid for years of service, which feeds into the personnel costs in future town budgets and warrant articles.
Voters at town meeting may be asked to approve the longevity article as amended, so the grandfathering terms are what residents would be voting on.
watch_next: The select board's handling of the amended SAP longevity article, and whether it goes to annual town meeting or is deferred to fall town meeting.
The warrant article's final wording, which should show how the grandfathering and the new-hire schedules are written.
